# TEDAC AH-64D — STM32H723ZGT6 Implementation Notes

Technical reference to avoid repeating the same bugs in future
USB HID + ADC DMA + GPIO implementations on the STM32H7 family.

---

## 1. ADC with Circular DMA — STM32H723

### Bugs generated by CubeMX (do NOT trust generated code for multi-channel ADC)

CubeMX generates incorrect ADC configuration when multiple channels are
configured. Always verify and fix manually:

| HAL field | CubeMX value (WRONG) | Correct value |
|---|---|---|
| `ScanConvMode` | `ADC_SCAN_DISABLE` | `ADC_SCAN_ENABLE` |
| `NbrOfConversion` | `1` | real number of channels (e.g. 6) |
| `EOCSelection` | `ADC_EOC_SINGLE_CONV` | `ADC_EOC_SEQ_CONV` |
| `Overrun` | `ADC_OVR_DATA_PRESERVED` | `ADC_OVR_DATA_OVERWRITTEN` |
| Channel sequence | Repeated/wrong | Verify Rank1..N with no duplicates |

### PCSEL_RES0 register (critical for STM32H723)

The STM32H723 requires pre-selecting each ADC channel in the PCSEL register
**before** enabling the ADC (ADEN=0). Without this the ADC silently samples
floating inputs.

- In the `ADC_TypeDef` struct of the H723, this register is named `PCSEL_RES0`
  (name shared with the ADC3 reserved field).
- **Must be written in `USER CODE BEGIN ADC1_Init 1`**, before `HAL_ADC_Init()`.
- If written after (with ADEN=1), the hardware ignores the write without error.

```c
/* USER CODE BEGIN ADC1_Init 1 */
__HAL_RCC_ADC12_CLK_ENABLE();  // required to access the register
ADC1->PCSEL_RES0 = (1UL << 3)   /* CH3  = PA6 */
                 | (1UL << 7)   /* CH7  = PA7 */
                 | (1UL << 10)  /* CH10 = PC0 */
                 | (1UL << 11)  /* CH11 = PC1 */
                 | (1UL << 14)  /* CH14 = PA2 */
                 | (1UL << 15); /* CH15 = PA3 */
/* USER CODE END ADC1_Init 1 */
```

### ADC1 pinout — 6 joystick axes

| Pin | ADC channel  | Rank | adc_buf[] | HID Axis   |
|-----|--------------|------|-----------|------------|
| PA6 | ADC1_IN3     | 1    | [0]       | X Axis     |
| PA7 | ADC1_IN7     | 2    | [1]       | Y Axis     |
| PA2 | ADC1_IN14    | 3    | [2]       | Z Axis     |
| PA3 | ADC1_IN15    | 4    | [3]       | X Rotation |
| PC0 | ADC1_IN10    | 5    | [4]       | Y Rotation |
| PC1 | ADC1_IN11    | 6    | [5]       | Z Rotation |

Potentiometer wiring: 3V3 → end A, GND → end B, WIPER → ADC pin.
GPIO mode: Analog, NoPull.

### Complete correct HAL configuration

```c
hadc1.Init.ClockPrescaler        = ADC_CLOCK_ASYNC_DIV2;
hadc1.Init.Resolution            = ADC_RESOLUTION_16B;
hadc1.Init.ScanConvMode          = ADC_SCAN_ENABLE;
hadc1.Init.EOCSelection          = ADC_EOC_SEQ_CONV;
hadc1.Init.LowPowerAutoWait      = DISABLE;
hadc1.Init.ContinuousConvMode    = ENABLE;
hadc1.Init.NbrOfConversion       = 6;
hadc1.Init.DiscontinuousConvMode = DISABLE;
hadc1.Init.ExternalTrigConv      = ADC_SOFTWARE_START;
hadc1.Init.ExternalTrigConvEdge  = ADC_EXTERNALTRIGCONVEDGE_NONE;
hadc1.Init.ConversionDataManagement = ADC_CONVERSIONDATA_DMA_CIRCULAR;
hadc1.Init.Overrun               = ADC_OVR_DATA_OVERWRITTEN;
hadc1.Init.LeftBitShift          = ADC_LEFTBITSHIFT_NONE;
hadc1.Init.OversamplingMode      = DISABLE;
```

### Debugger verification (GDB commands)

After flashing, halt and run:

```
p/x ADC1->CR          // bit0=ADEN=1, bit2=ADSTART=1 → ADC running
p/x ADC1->CFGR        // bits1:0=0b11=DMA circular, bit13=CONT=1
p/x ADC1->SQR1        // bits3:0=L=5 (6 conversions), check SQ1..SQ4
p/x ADC1->SQR2        // check SQ5=10 (CH10), SQ6=11 (CH11)
p/x ADC1->PCSEL_RES0  // bits 3,7,10,11,14,15 must be set
p/x ADC1->ISR         // bit0=ADRDY, bit3=EOS expected
p adc_buf[0]          // value between 0 and 65535
```

## 2. DMA + D-Cache — STM32H7

### Problem

The Cortex-M7 has a 16 KB D-Cache. If the DMA buffer is in RAM_D1
(cache enabled), the CPU reads stale values from cache even after the
DMA has written new ones.

### Solution — double defense

**A) Buffer in RAM_D2 (preferred):**

RAM_D2 (0x30000000) is accessible by DMA1/DMA2 and can be marked
non-cacheable by the MPU. DMA buffers should ALWAYS go here.

```c
// Declaration
volatile uint16_t adc_buf[6] __attribute__((section(".RAM_D2")));

// Linker script (STM32H723ZGTX_FLASH.ld)
.RAM_D2 (NOLOAD) :
{
    . = ALIGN(4);
    *(.RAM_D2)
    *(.RAM_D2.*)
    . = ALIGN(4);
} >RAM_D2
```

**B) MPU non-cacheable region for RAM_D2:**

```c
// In MPU_Config(), add Region 1 after the background region:
MPU_InitStruct.Number           = MPU_REGION_NUMBER1;
MPU_InitStruct.BaseAddress      = 0x30000000;
MPU_InitStruct.Size             = MPU_REGION_SIZE_32KB;
MPU_InitStruct.SubRegionDisable = 0x00;
MPU_InitStruct.TypeExtField     = MPU_TEX_LEVEL1;   // TEX=1, C=0, B=0
MPU_InitStruct.AccessPermission = MPU_REGION_FULL_ACCESS;
MPU_InitStruct.DisableExec      = MPU_INSTRUCTION_ACCESS_DISABLE;
MPU_InitStruct.IsShareable      = MPU_ACCESS_NOT_SHAREABLE;
MPU_InitStruct.IsCacheable      = MPU_ACCESS_NOT_CACHEABLE;
MPU_InitStruct.IsBufferable     = MPU_ACCESS_NOT_BUFFERABLE;
HAL_MPU_ConfigRegion(&MPU_InitStruct);
```

**C) Invalidate cache in callbacks (extra defense):**

```c
void HAL_ADC_ConvCpltCallback(ADC_HandleTypeDef *hadc)
{
    if (hadc->Instance == ADC1)
        SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((uint32_t *)adc_buf, sizeof(adc_buf));
}
void HAL_ADC_ConvHalfCpltCallback(ADC_HandleTypeDef *hadc)
{
    if (hadc->Instance == ADC1)
        SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((uint32_t *)adc_buf, sizeof(adc_buf));
}
```

## 3. USB Custom HID — Report Buffer and Endpoint

### Bug: buffer on the stack

`USBD_CUSTOM_HID_SendReport` starts a DMA transfer. If the buffer is
on the stack of a function, once the function returns the stack is
reused and the DMA reads corrupted data.

```c
// WRONG — local buffer on stack:
void JOYSTICK_SendReport(void) {
    uint8_t report[21];  // ← dangerous with USB DMA
    ...
    USBD_CUSTOM_HID_SendReport(..., report, 21);
}

// CORRECT — static buffer at fixed address:
static uint8_t report[21];
void JOYSTICK_SendReport(void) { ... }
```

### Bug: endpoint saturation

If `USBD_CUSTOM_HID_SendReport` is called while the IN endpoint is
busy, it returns `USBD_BUSY` and in some middleware versions leaves
the internal state corrupted, blocking future sends.

Always check the state before sending:

```c
void JOYSTICK_SendReport(void)
{
    USBD_CUSTOM_HID_HandleTypeDef *hhid =
        (USBD_CUSTOM_HID_HandleTypeDef *)hUsbDeviceHS.pClassData;

    if (hhid == NULL || hhid->state == CUSTOM_HID_BUSY)
        return;  // next timer tick will send with fresh values

    // ... pack report ...
    USBD_CUSTOM_HID_SendReport(&hUsbDeviceHS, report, sizeof(report));
}
```

### ADC → HID axis conversion

The ADC produces unsigned 16-bit values (0–65535).
The HID descriptor declares signed 16-bit axes (–32768 to +32767).

```c
int16_t val = (int16_t)((int32_t)adc_buf[i] - 32768);
report[i * 2]     = (uint8_t)(val & 0xFF);        // low byte
report[i * 2 + 1] = (uint8_t)((val >> 8) & 0xFF); // high byte
```

### HID descriptor — report structure (21 bytes)

```
Bytes  0-11 : 6 axes × 2 bytes (signed 16-bit, little-endian)
Bytes 12-20 : 72 buttons in 9 bytes (72 bits, no padding needed)
```

```c
// Axes:
0x75, 0x10,  // Report Size (16)
0x95, 0x06,  // Report Count (6)    → 6 axes
0x81, 0x02,  // Input (Data, Var, Abs)

// Buttons (72 = 9 bytes exactly, zero padding):
0x75, 0x01,  // Report Size (1)
0x95, 0x48,  // Report Count (72)   → 72 buttons
0x81, 0x02,  // Input (Data, Var, Abs)
```

Descriptor size: **49 bytes** (`USBD_CUSTOM_HID_REPORT_DESC_SIZE` in `usbd_conf.h`).

> **Note on button count vs. padding:**
> - 69 buttons → 69 bits → 3 padding bits → 9 bytes (descriptor = 55 bytes)
> - 72 buttons → 72 bits → **0 padding bits** → 9 bytes (descriptor = 49 bytes)
> Report payload stays at **21 bytes** in both cases.

## 4. GPIO — Digital Buttons

### Configuration

- Mode: `GPIO_MODE_INPUT`
- Pull: `GPIO_PULLUP` (inverted logic: RESET = pressed)

### Reading

```c
// Button pressed when pin reads LOW (PULLUP + switch to GND)
if (HAL_GPIO_ReadPin(port, pin) == GPIO_PIN_RESET)
    report[12 + (i / 8)] |= (1U << (i % 8));
```

### Pin distribution — 72 buttons

| Buttons | Port   | Pins               |
|---------|--------|--------------------|
| 01–16   | GPIOE  | PE0–PE15           |
| 17–21   | GPIOD  | PD8–PD12           |
| 22–29   | GPIOD  | PD0–PD7            |
| 30–43   | GPIOB  | PB0–PB13           |
| 44–47   | GPIOC  | PC4–PC7            |
| 48–53   | GPIOC  | PC8–PC13           |
| 54–60   | GPIOF  | PF0–PF6            |
| 61–69   | GPIOG  | PG6–PG14           |
| 70      | GPIOG  | PG15 (TDU Off)     |
| 71–72   | GPIOF  | PF7–PF8 (Spare)    |

---

## 5. STM32H723 Memory Architecture

| Region       | Address    | Size  | Use                                  |
|--------------|------------|-------|--------------------------------------|
| FLASH        | 0x08000000 | 1 MB  | Code                                 |
| RAM_D1 (AXI) | 0x24000000 | 320 KB| Stack, heap, general variables       |
| RAM_D2       | 0x30000000 | 32 KB | **DMA buffers** (DMA1/DMA2)          |
| RAM_D3       | 0x38000000 | 16 KB | DMA4/BDMA buffers                    |
| DTCMRAM      | 0x20000000 | 128 KB| Real-time critical variables         |

**Rule:** Any buffer used by DMA1 or DMA2 **MUST** be in RAM_D2.
DMA1/DMA2 cannot access RAM_D1 (AXI bus, D1 domain).

---

## 6. Checklist for new ADC + DMA + HID implementations

- [ ] DMA buffer in RAM_D2 with `__attribute__((section(".RAM_D2")))`
- [ ] `.RAM_D2 (NOLOAD)` section in linker script pointing to `>RAM_D2`
- [ ] MPU non-cacheable region for 0x30000000 (32 KB)
- [ ] `PCSEL_RES0` written **before** `HAL_ADC_Init()` (with ADEN=0)
- [ ] `ScanConvMode = ADC_SCAN_ENABLE`
- [ ] `NbrOfConversion` matches the real number of channels
- [ ] `EOCSelection = ADC_EOC_SEQ_CONV`
- [ ] `Overrun = ADC_OVR_DATA_OVERWRITTEN`
- [ ] Channels in Rank1..N with no duplicates, in correct order
- [ ] `HAL_ADCEx_Calibration_Start` before `HAL_ADC_Start_DMA`
- [ ] USB report buffer declared `static`, not on stack
- [ ] Check `hhid->state != CUSTOM_HID_BUSY` before `SendReport`
- [ ] Analog GPIOs: mode=Analog, pull=NoPull
- [ ] Digital GPIOs: mode=Input, pull=PullUp (if switch to GND)
